verdict_reason: The regenerated oracles match the new mapper and obligations, but they pin commodity.name as a bare CN code, which goes against the ticket's decision to send the commodity description.

todos.issue: The oracle now pins the outbound notification's commodity.name to a bare CN code ('0102' at lines 867, 1191, 1712; '01063300' at 2017) where it was the commodity name ('Cow'). commodity.name feeds GBN-AG TradeLineItem description/commonName and the ins-backend notification cards (docs/analysis/gbn-ag-field-lineage.md section 2), so PIMS and the INS dashboard would show '0102'. The ticket's 14 Oct decision 3 says a line sends the commodity description (added by reference-data), not the code. The source is mapper-a/commodity.js commodityFromLinesA (name: lines[0].commodityCode).
todos.fix: Must: the commodity.name sent on the record is the agreed value for that field (the commodity description, or a decision recorded on the ticket that the code is intended), and this oracle pins that value. One way: carry the description on the line, map it in commodityFromLinesA, and regenerate the oracle; or record the decision on EUDPA-617 if the code is deliberate for now.
